posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
@Powerhound2000: I'm reminded of when someone over on Reddit said they thought they imagined Grandpa Legacy having an old-timey radio announcer type voice. Clearly we need Adam to voice Grandpa Legacy.

I now like Absolute Zero even more after listening to this because he basically seems kinda like me without the geekiness: Pessimistic, snarky/cynical, beat on/up a lot, questioning their purpose in life, being lonely but having trouble interacting with people, big music aficionado (though I admit I'm more into folk music than R&B).

Seems like AZ is the Sentinels Music History/Culture major to Argent's Music Theory/Performance person. I wasn't expecting that, but I dig it.

posts.name: KateWalker
posts.cooked:
I was surprised how closely I can identify with Absolute Zero.

I've always said he's one of if not my favorite hero to play. I've got an affinity for ice-powered heroes, and I love being able to damage myself to heal. But that line, "Everything's always been terrible"? That's something I say all the time. And what follows it, what he says, that's pretty inspiring. I'm gonna have to remember it the next time I'm feeling unmotivated.
